title: PerformanceEval
$comment: Describes the YAML frontmatter of a data/evaluation/*.md file. The Markdown body below the frontmatter holds freeform review notes. Kept lightweight for MVP.

id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation, e.g. "eval-2026-annual".

period.description: The time period this evaluation covers, e.g. "2026", "2026-H1", "2026-Q3".

type.description: The format or type of the evaluation, e.g. "annual_360", "mid_year_review", "probation_review".

eval_date.description: The date the evaluation was delivered or finalized, YYYY-MM-DD.

attendees.description: Names/handles of people present during the evaluation delivery (e.g. employee, manager).

strengths.description: Key positive feedback points or areas where expectations were exceeded.

growth_areas.description: Areas for improvement identified in the evaluation. Often references IDPAction IDs (e.g. "idp-2026-001") if the growth area is translated into a formal goal.
